aboutus.banner.desc: Guqula indawo yakho yokuhlala ngeekhaphethi zethu ezinobunewunewu, apho isitayile kunye nentuthuzelo idibana kuyo yonke ifayibha.
aboutus.desc: Wamkelekile kwi-Al-Barkaat Rugs, apho isithethe sidibana nokuqaliswa kwezinto ezintsha kwihlabathi leengubo zomgangatho ezigqwesileyo. Ukuthanda kwethu iiragi zendele ngokunzulu kuzo zonke iifayibha, kwaye sinebhongo elikhulu ngokunibonisa uluhlu olucokisekileyo lweeragi ezintle ezibonisa ubunewunewu, intuthuzelo, kunye nobutyebi benkcubeko. Nokuba ufuna ukufaka indawo yakho ngokufudumala kwesithethe, umtsalane woyilo lwangoku, okanye umdibaniso wazo zombini, iiragi zethu zenzelwe ukugqitha ukuhombisa nje kwaye zibe ziindlalifa ezixabisekileyo kwikhaya lakho okanye kwiofisi yakho. Ngena kwindawo apho ubuchwephesha budibana nelifa lemveli, apho uyilo olungaphelelwa lixesha luthungelana kunye neemvakalelo zale mihla-fumana umbhoxo ogqibeleleyo wokuxhasa isitayile sakho kwaye uphakamise indawo ohlala kuyo eAl-Barkaat Rugs.
aboutus.service1: Ukutyhilwa kweXabiso eliNgaqhelekanga: Injongo yethu ijikeleze ekutyebiseni amava akho ngamaxabiso akhuphisanayo, ukukhuthaza intsebenziswano, kunye nokunikezela ngenkonzo engenakuthelekiswa nanto.
aboutus.service2: Ukuphakamisa ukuGqwesa: Uhambo lwethu luzinze kusukelo olungayekeleliyo lwemfezeko. Ngokuzinikezela ngamandla ekwenzeni izinto ezintsha kunye nokuzinikela okungagungqiyo ekuqinisekiseni ukwaneliseka kwakho kangangoko, sizama ukucacisa ngokutsha imigangatho yeshishini. Sijoyine njengoko siqalisa uhambo olusingise kwikamva eliqaqambileyo, elinempumelelo ngakumbi.
aboutus.service3: Ukwamkela Amathuba angapheliyo: Umbono wethu udlulela ngaphaya kwemida njengoko siwola usuku ngalunye oluphuphuma ngamathuba amatsha okukhula kunye nendaleko. Sizinikezele kwikamva elikhuthazwa kukuyila izinto ezintsha, inkqubela phambili, kunye nesakhono esingenasiphelo, siyakumema ukuba udibane nathi ekuqulunqeni ibali langomso.
aboutus.service4: Ixabiso Lokwenza Ubuchule, Ukuqinisekisa UkuGqwesa: Siyazingca kakhulu ngokuzibophelela kwethu ekuboneleleni ngawona maxabiso akhuphisanayo kushishino. Usukelo lwethu olungayekiyo lokuphumelela kweendleko kunye nokukhangela ngobuchule kusivumela ukuba sandise ukonga kakhulu kuwe. Sikholelwa ngokuqinileyo ukuba ukufikeleleka akufuneki kubeke esichengeni umgangatho wenkonzo okanye iimveliso ozifumanayo. Ngaloo ndlela, sigcina ugxininiso olungagungqiyo ekunikezeni ixabiso elingenakulinganiswa kunye nokugqwesa.
